tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Always carries the paper grain. Night session flips to deep harbor navy.

tokens.name: linen
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, sheets, the nav bar. Also the text color on ink, pool and clay fills in Day session.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo's paper. Sunken areas, table zebra rows, input wells, inactive chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Sampled from the logo's brush. All primary text, primary buttons, the brush ring and awning stripes. 11.8:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, court and time, table headers. 5.6:1 on paper, 4.75:1 on sand.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons sitting on an ink fill (primary button, active chip).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, card borders, table rules. Borders over shadows, always.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons). Meets 3:1 against paper and linen (Day opacity raised from 0.42 to 0.52 to get there).

tokens.name: pool
tokens.usage: Resort-pool teal, the evolution of Teal Ace. Wins, confirmations, links. Text-safe on paper and linen.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Terracotta court. Live matches, match point, the one thing happening now. Use once per screen.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Late-afternoon yellow, a nod to the ball. Decorative only: the ball dot, a highlight swash. Never text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and form errors only. Paired with an icon or label, never color alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px.

styles.name: title-italic
styles.usage: The vacation voice: empty states, celebratory lines, pull quotes. Sparingly.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Set scores and standings points. Always tabular lining figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mike confirmed for Saturday at Beacon Courts.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, table headers, chip text. Always uppercase. The Wilson heritage tag.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section breaks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room. Be generous; resorts are never crowded.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, table cells, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, lists, score wells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons, chips, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only for things that float: sheets, menus, the toast. Cards use a hairline instead.
